verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships automations that run the agent on schedules, pushes, or integration events, and the agent opens pull requests for review. Nothing in the evidence shows that the automation definitions themselves can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The PR review applies to the agent's content output, and instant rollbacks apply to Enterprise site deployments; both are adjacent features, not version control over automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
